page.title: Profile Settings
page.subtitle: Manage your account information and settings

professionalStatus.label: Professional Status: {status}
professionalStatus.pendingNotice: Your profile is under review. You will be notified within 48 hours.
professionalStatus.approvedNotice: Your professional profile has been approved. You can now receive project bookings.

vat.title: VAT Information
vat.description: Add your VAT number for EU tax compliance. EU VAT numbers will be verified using VIES.
vat.customerNote: Useful for business customers who need VAT invoices.
vat.formatHint: Format: 2-letter country code + 4-15 characters (e.g., DE123456789, FR12345678901)
vat.reverseChargeHint: B2B reverse charge will not apply until VIES verifies this number. Check the value and click Validate again.
vat.onlyEu: Only EU VAT numbers can be validated with VIES

business.title: Business Information
business.description: Complete your business profile to attract more clients
business.usernameHint: This is how customers see you. Your company name is only visible to administrators.
business.usernameRules: 3-30 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
business.noServices: No services available for your country. Please make sure your country is set correctly above; the list will update when you change the country.

documents.title: Identity Documents
documents.description: Upload your ID proof for verification. Required for professional approval.
documents.acceptedFormats: Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG, PDF. Maximum size: 5MB
documents.changeWarning: Changing ID information will trigger a re-verification. Your professional status will be set to pending until an admin re-approves your profile.

payments.title: Payment Setup
payments.description: Connect your Stripe account to receive payments from customers
payments.incomplete: Stripe account connected, but setup is not fully complete.
payments.intro: Set up your Stripe account to start accepting payments. You'll be guided through Stripe's secure onboarding process.
payments.loadFailed: Failed to load Stripe account status

personalAvailability.title: Availability Calendar
personalAvailability.description: Weekly view with bookings, buffers, personal blocks, and company closures. Click personal blocks to edit.
personalAvailability.addBlockedHint: Choose the exact start and end time for the blocked period.
personalAvailability.calendarDescription: Booking details are shown inside each block. Click personal blocks to edit.
personalAvailability.workingHoursDescription: Read-only. Working hours follow the company schedule.
personalAvailability.supportEventsFailed: Support meetings could not be loaded, so this calendar may be incomplete.

companyAvailability.title: Company Availability & Holidays
companyAvailability.description: Set company-wide schedule that team members can inherit
companyAvailability.closuresDescription: Block company-wide closure periods. These appear on the calendar below.
companyAvailability.calendarDescription: Click a closure block to remove it.
companyAvailability.workingHoursDescription: Set company office hours for your team. The weekly calendar window updates automatically.
companyAvailability.saveFailed: Failed to save company blocked periods

customer.vatDescription: Add your VAT number for EU tax compliance and invoicing. Business name and company address will be prefilled after VAT validation.
customer.prefillHint: These fields are automatically prefilled when you validate your VAT number.

dialogs.editDescription: Adjust the time range or remove the block.
dialogs.autoPopulateDescription: We found company information from your VAT registration. Would you like to auto-fill your business details?
dialogs.onlyEmptyFields: Only empty fields will be filled. Your existing data will not be overwritten.
dialogs.changeIdDescription: Changing your ID information will require admin re-verification. Your professional status will be set to {status} and you will not be able to receive new bookings until an admin re-approves your profile.
dialogs.uploadIdDescription: Uploading a new ID document will require admin re-verification. Your professional status will be set to {status} and you will not be able to receive new bookings until an admin re-approves your profile.

toasts.bookingEventsFailed: Failed to load booking events. Please refresh to try again.
toasts.viesSavedWarning: VAT number saved, but VIES is temporarily unavailable. Reverse charge will not apply until the number is verified — click Validate again in a few minutes.
toasts.vatSavedNotVerified: VAT number saved but not verified by VIES. B2B reverse charge will not apply until it is verified.
toasts.businessPrefilled: Business information prefilled from VAT validation
toasts.invalidTimes: Please provide valid start and end times
toasts.cannotBlockPastTime: Cannot block time in the past
toasts.cannotBlockPastDates: Cannot block dates in the past
toasts.endInPast: End time cannot be in the past
toasts.startBeforeEnd: Start must be before end time
toasts.endAfterStart: End time must be after start time
toasts.blockedDays: {days, plural, one {Blocked # day from {start} to {end}} other {Blocked # days from {start} to {end}}}
toasts.blockedHours: {hours, plural, one {Blocked # hour on {date}} other {Blocked # hours on {date}}}
toasts.autoPopulated: Business information auto-populated from VAT data!
toasts.submitSuccess: Thanks for submitting. Your profile will be checked within 48 hours.
toasts.completeRequirementsGeneric: Complete the missing profile requirements before submitting for verification.

passwordChange.title: Change Password
passwordChange.description: Update your account password for security
passwordChange.minLength: Password must be at least 6 characters long
passwordChange.tooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
passwordChange.sameAsCurrent: New password must be different from current password

privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.description: Download a copy of your data or permanently delete your account. Financial records (bookings, payments, invoices) are retained as required by law even after account deletion.
privacy.downloadDescription: Export everything we hold about you as a JSON file (bookings, messages, projects, points, etc.).
privacy.deleteDescription: Removes your personal information and signs you out. This cannot be undone.
privacy.dialogDescription: This will remove your name, email, phone, and other personal details. Bookings, payments, and invoices will be kept on file for legal record-keeping but will no longer be linked to your identifiable profile. You will be logged out immediately and cannot log in again.

vatFormat.countryPrefix: VAT number must start with 2 letters (country code)
vatFormat.invalidCountry: {country} is not a valid EU country code
vatFormat.network: Network error occurred while validating VAT number
